country:favourite.label: Star this country
country:favourite.label__note: Accessibility label on the star toggle in the country header. Announced with its on/off state, so it names the thing rather than the action. Max 24 characters.
country:facts.title: What to know
country:facts.title__note: Section heading above the list of facts. Max 18 characters.
country:attribute.location__note: Fact label. Max 14 characters. Which continent the country is on. The pack answers with Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania or Antarctica.
country:fact.hidden__note: Replaces the answer on a fact the user has not met, so the page does not spoil it. Max 18 characters.
country:fact.due__note: Badge on a fact that is due today. Max 18 characters.
country:fact.label: {attribute}: {value}, {mastery}
country:fact.label__note: Accessibility label grouping one fact row.
country:progress__note: Facts learned for this country. Both are whole numbers.
country:missing.title: We do not have this one yet
country:missing.body: More of the world arrives with every content update.
country:attribute.callingCode__note: Label for the international dialling-code fact on a country page. Never abbreviate to "Code" — the page also carries currency and continent, and a bare "Code" names none of them. Max 16 characters.
country:attribute.area__note: Fact label. The country's size, such as "about 380,000 km²". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.borders__note: Fact label. One row listing every country that shares a land border. Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.borderCount__note: Fact label. How many countries share a land border, a number such as "9". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.landlocked__note: Fact label. Whether the country touches the sea — "a landlocked country" or "a country with a sea coast". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.hemisphere__note: Fact label. Which quarter of the world the country lies wholly inside, such as "Northern and Eastern". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.tld__note: Fact label. The country's internet domain, such as ".se". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.alpha3__note: Fact label. The ISO 3166-1 three-letter country code, such as "SWE". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.currencyCode__note: Fact label. The ISO 4217 code of the money, such as "SEK". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.nativeName__note: Fact label. What the country's own people call it, such as "Sverige". Max 14 characters.
country:attribute.company__note: Label for an authored fact in the full country reference. Names and fact values come from the content catalogue.
